items.title: Kimberly Clark (KMB) Reaffirms Dividend Following Rally While Valuation Debate Builds
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark (KMB) has reaffirmed its regular quarterly dividend at $1.28 per share, payable on January 5, 2027. This maintains a 92-year dividend payment streak and a 54-year run of consecutive annual dividend increases. Kimberly-Clark’s reaffirmed payout lands at a time when the share price has picked up some momentum, with a 1-month share price return of 10.08% and a year-to-date share price gain of 7.92%, while the 1-year total shareholder return is 10.59%.
